page.overview:
Who is Player Character?

The Player Character of Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 is the main protagonist of the aforementioned game.

Both the male and female Player Characters were designed by original author Akira Toriyama.

In promotional material the male is used to represent the Saiyan race, while the female is used for Earthlings.

By default, the male player character has white hair styled in a bowl cut, and the female player character has orange hair styled in a bob. Both wear the Great Saiyan Squad uniform consisting of a dark gray jumpsuit with the Great Saiyan Squad logo on the left bicep in white as well as a white line running down the outer leg, a lime green zip-up vest with red shoulders and the text featuring the text "CAPSULE CORP" over the left breast, a gold belt with a silver front emblazoned with the Capsule Corporation logo, and Battle Armor boots with dark gray soles and heels and red tongues featuring the Capsule Corporation logo. The uniform overall resembles a futuristic version of Gohan's Great Saiyaman Suit.
